# Requirements Quality Checklist: GitHub App Installation and Repository Onboarding

**Purpose**: Check whether the written requirements of Feature 001 are observable, testable, unambiguous and complete in the security-relevant areas (authorization, installation lifecycle, webhooks, tenancy, secrets, scope). This checks the wording of the spec, not any implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: Formal gate before `/speckit-tasks`. **Audience**: spec author and security reviewer.
**Reviewed**: 2026-09-29, agent-assisted at the reviewer's explicit request against the current spec.md. Passing items are marked `[x]`; items with a **Finding** remain open.

## Requirement Observability

- [x] CHK001 Does every functional requirement state an outcome a user or an external observer can see (screen content, response, stored record, audit entry), rather than an internal intention? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Are the terms "setting up" state, "clear message", and "explanation" (empty installation) defined with the content a user must see? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1-4, §US2-5, §Edge Cases] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK003 Is "appears/updates automatically" for the setting-up state given an observable limit (how soon, and what the user sees if the limit is exceeded)? [Measurability, Spec §US2-5] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK004 Are "browsable and searchable" for very large repository lists specified as observable behavior (what can be filtered, how results are shown)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK005 Is "stored safely" for an event about an unknown installation replaced by an observable outcome? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5-5]
- [x] CHK006 Is "next checked" in the removed-member scenario tied to the specific moments in FR-037/FR-038, so the observable point of loss of access is unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §US6-3]

## Acceptance Criteria Testability

- [x] CHK007 Does every functional requirement (FR-001 to FR-039) map to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK008 Can each success criterion (SC-001 to SC-012) be evaluated without knowing the implementation, and is the measurement method or population stated (for example, "95% of cases" over what sample)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-012] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK009 Is "immediately" in SC-008 defined as a bound (for example, a maximum time or "before the next request")? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are acceptance scenarios written with a concrete initial state, action and expected result, with no scenario relying on undefined terms like "sufficient rights"? [Clarity, Spec §US3] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK011 Are there acceptance scenarios for FR-016 (manual re-synchronization) that cover an unauthorized requester and a repeated request? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §US4-7] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK012 Is a scenario present for sign-out and session expiry, or is their absence a stated decision? [Gap, Spec §US1] — Resolved 2026-09-29: US1 scenario 6.
- [x] CHK013 Does FR-019 (the Installation → Organization → Repositories → Enable hierarchy) have a measurable or observable acceptance condition? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).

## Authorization Boundaries

- [x] CHK014 Are the actions each role (OWNER, MEMBER, unauthenticated visitor) may perform listed in one place, covering view, enable/disable, sync, install and refresh access? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK015 Is the wording "authorized users" (FR-018) and "authorized for the organization" consistent with the OWNER/MEMBER model in FR-035, or does it leave a third undefined class? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-035] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK016 Is it stated who may start the install flow, and whether that requires any role, given that GitHub decides who can complete installation? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK017 Are the events at which role and access are confirmed with GitHub (sign-in, refresh, before management) listed exhaustively, with the 10-minute rule applying only to management actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036–FR-038] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK018 Is behavior specified for a user whose role is confirmed as owner in one organization and member in another within the same session? [Coverage, Spec §US6-4]
- [x] CHK019 Does the spec define who can see an installation whose event arrived before any user has been linked to that account, and how a user becomes authorized for it? [Gap, Spec §US5-5, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK020 Is the treatment of GitHub roles other than owner and plain member (billing manager, custom role, outside collaborator) stated as an explicit rule? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK021 Is the distinction between "installation ID as authorization boundary" (FR-009) and user authorization (FR-010) stated so a reader knows which check applies to which request? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010] — Resolved 2026-09-29: FR-009 (membership for user requests, installation ID for GitHub-triggered work).

## Installation Lifecycle

- [x] CHK022 Are all installation states and every permitted transition between them defined in the spec (not only in the plan), including terminal states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-024–FR-027] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK023 Is the state shown to the user defined for each lifecycle phase: not yet confirmed, active with sync in progress, active and synced, sync failed, suspended, removed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §US2-5, §FR-017] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for an installation the user abandons partway (started, not completed) and for an installation completed on GitHub but never visited in CodeLens? [Coverage, Spec §US2-6, §US5-5]
- [x] CHK025 Are the effects of GitHub changing the repository selection of an installation ("all" versus "selected") after installation specified? [Gap, Spec §US2-3, §US2-4]
- [x] CHK026 Is the meaning of a "new" installation after reinstall (FR-026) consistent with the acceptance scenario and with how the removed installation is displayed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, §US4-6]
- [x] CHK027 Is a retention rule stated for removed installations and inaccessible repositories ("retained history"), or its absence an explicit decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-024]

## Uninstall Behavior

- [x] CHK028 Does FR-024 list every observable consequence of uninstall (installation status, each repository's state, review eligibility, visibility in the UI, audit entry)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK029 Is the "1 minute" bound for uninstall in SC-009 measured from a defined starting event (GitHub reports vs. user action on GitHub)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK030 Is it specified what happens to review work already accepted or in progress at the moment of uninstall or suspension? [Gap, Spec §FR-022, §FR-024, §FR-025] — Resolved 2026-09-29: Assumptions (owned by the future review feature).
- [x] CHK031 Is the behavior when an uninstall event arrives for an installation CodeLens has never recorded stated? [Coverage, Spec §US5-4, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Are the requirements for removed data consistent between uninstall (installation-level) and repository removal (repository-level) so that both keep history and disable review? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-024]

## Webhook Authenticity

- [x] CHK033 Does the spec say what makes an event "authentic" in product terms (proof that GitHub sent it, unmodified) and that the check happens before any effect? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028] — Resolved 2026-09-29: FR-028 (definition of authentic).
- [x] CHK034 Are all forms of invalid authentication covered: missing proof, wrong proof, malformed proof, and proof for a modified body? [Coverage, Spec §US5-1]
- [x] CHK035 Is the record kept of a rejected event specified (what it may and must not contain) and how long it is kept? [Gap, Spec §US5-1] — Resolved 2026-09-29: US5 scenario 1 (record contents, 30-day retention).
- [x] CHK036 Is the response required to the sender for rejected, duplicate and accepted events stated in observable terms, including that rejected events reveal nothing useful? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, §FR-031] — Resolved 2026-09-29: FR-028 (identical responses).
- [x] CHK037 Are requirements stated for a valid event about an installation, repository or account not recognized by CodeLens (ignored, stored, or rejected)? [Gap, Spec §US5-5]

## Duplicate and Out-of-Order Events

- [x] CHK038 Is "the same event" defined precisely enough to distinguish a redelivery from a new event with the same content? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-029] — Resolved 2026-09-29: FR-029 (same delivery identifier).
- [x] CHK039 Is "at most once in effect" (FR-029) made testable by naming the records that must not be duplicated (installations, repositories, audit entries, notifications)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-029, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK040 Are concurrent duplicate deliveries and duplicate deliveries after a long delay both addressed? [Coverage, Spec §US5-2, §US5-3]
- [x] CHK041 Is "correct final state" for out-of-order events (FR-030) defined by a rule (GitHub's current state wins) rather than by example alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, §US5-4]
- [x] CHK042 Is behavior specified when GitHub is unavailable while processing an event, including whether the event is retried and for how long? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §FR-031]

## Repository Synchronization Determinism

- [x] CHK043 Does the spec define which GitHub attributes determine repository identity and which can change without creating a new repository? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §US4-3]
- [x] CHK044 Is "resolved deterministically" for a repository reported by two installations replaced by an explicit rule that yields one result for the same inputs? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK045 Is the state after a repeat synchronization defined in terms of what must be unchanged (records, timestamps shown to the user, audit entries)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK046 Are requirements defined for partial synchronization failure that specify what the user sees and what data must remain untouched? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK047 Is the retry behavior for failed synchronization (manual only, automatic, limit) stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK048 Are the state changes that synchronization may make to a repository's enabled/disabled flag listed, including a repository that returns after being removed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK049 Is the maximum repository count the spec supports stated, or the behavior above the 500-repository figure in SC-003? [Gap, Spec §SC-003, §Edge Cases]

## Tenant Isolation

- [x] CHK050 Is the tenant boundary defined once (organization, with installation and repository beneath it) and used consistently in every requirement that scopes data? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK051 Does the isolation requirement cover every place tenant data can appear: screens, direct-identifier requests, search, counts, error messages, audit views and logs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, §US6] — Resolved 2026-09-29: FR-020 (all user-visible outputs).
- [x] CHK052 Is the required response for an out-of-scope resource stated so that existence is not revealed, and is it consistent across "not found" and "not permitted" cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §US6-2]
- [x] CHK053 Is behavior specified for a repository that moves between tenants (transfer) with respect to history visible to the former tenant? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK054 Are isolation requirements defined for background work (synchronization, event processing) and not only for user requests? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Secrets Protection

- [x] CHK055 Does FR-033 cover protection at rest (not stored in plaintext), in addition to non-exposure to clients, logs and source control? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK056 Is every secret class named in the security requirements covered by FR-033: GitHub App private key, webhook secret, OAuth/client secret, session secret, user and installation credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]
- [x] CHK057 Is FR-034 (short-lived credentials) consistent with SC-010 (no "installation credential" in browser content or logs), including the user's own GitHub credential during sign-in? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, §SC-010] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK058 Is the requirement that the private key never appears in repository source stated as a testable condition (for example, a scan of the repository and build output)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033] — Resolved 2026-09-29 (spec update: roles matrix FR-040, confirmation validity FR-036/037, transfer rule, states FR-041, messages and SC-013/014).
- [x] CHK059 Is it stated what happens when a secret is rotated or found compromised (sessions, webhook verification, private key), or is rotation intentionally out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-033] — Resolved 2026-09-29: Assumptions (rotation out of scope; replaceable by configuration).
- [x] CHK060 Are error messages and audit entries covered by the "no secret values" rule, and is the rule extended to webhook payload contents? [Coverage, Spec §US5-1, §FR-023]

## Scope Boundaries (Out-of-Scope Leakage)

- [x] CHK061 Does any requirement, scenario or entity imply a review, comment, approval or repository write that the out-of-scope list excludes? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-032]
- [x] CHK062 Is the eligibility rule (FR-022) worded as a rule for future consumers, without requiring review processing that does not exist yet? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK063 Is FR-032's permission wording consistent with the permission set in the architecture baseline and with FR-039's possible additional read permission? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, §FR-039]
- [x] CHK064 Do "Enable CodeLens" and "review" in FR-021 stop at recording the choice, with no configuration of review behavior, `.codelens.yml`, models or billing implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK065 Are the out-of-scope items listed in the spec identical to those in the feature request, with none silently dropped or added? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

- [x] CHK068 Do the entities in Key Entities describe business concepts and relationships rather than tables, columns or record formats? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]

- [x] CHK070 Does the baseline-alignment note stay a pointer to the architecture documents without restating schema in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §Architecture baseline alignment] — Resolved 2026-09-29: Architecture baseline alignment reduced to a pointer.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
